content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after a crypto payment enables creators to sell digital products without the burdensome fees imposed by traditional platforms. In contrast to platforms like Gumroad, which charges 10% per sale, utilizing NOWPayments allows creators to retain 99.5% of their revenue, significantly increasing profitability. For instance, if you sell a $97 ebook and make 100 sales a month, the difference in fees results in an extra $921 retained. This model not only streamlines the sales process but also enhances the financial independence of digital creators.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core architecture for automated ebook delivery leverages several free and reliable tools, ensuring that creators maintain sovereignty over their sales. Using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, the backend logic can handle payment verification and trigger automated product delivery. Upon successful payment via NOWPayments, an automatic webhook activates, delivering the ebook directly to the buyer. This seamless integration removes traditional payment obstacles and ensures that transactions are secure, fast, and efficient. The combination of open-source technologies and crypto payment solutions empowers creators with a robust infrastructure.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable. Whether you're an author, educator, or designer selling ebooks, courses, templates, or plugins, having a system that supports crypto payments is crucial. The framework allows you to bypass the constraints of traditional financial systems, enabling you to focus on creative output while enjoying the benefits of immediate sales revenue. By adopting this model, creators can maximize their income and reach a broader audience without the barriers imposed by platform dependencies.
Automated delivery means instant access for your customers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The primary components of this automated delivery infrastructure include Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. These elements work in unison to create a streamlined sales environment. You can store product data using Supabase or Google Sheets, ensuring that all transaction data is securely held. File delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, allowing for easy access and distribution of your ebooks. Each component contributes to an ecosystem where you own your data and sales, mitigating the risk of platform lock-in.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this automated ebook delivery system, start by setting up an account with NOWPayments for crypto processing. Then, create your ebook and host it on Google Drive. Use Google Apps Script to automate the delivery process by setting up a webhook that triggers when a payment is confirmed. Finally, host your sales page on Cloudflare Pages for free, directing customers to purchase your product. This hands-on approach empowers you to take control of your digital sales process without relying on traditional payment platforms.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Retain more revenue with lower fees than traditional platforms.

If you’re looking to dive deeper into building your digital storefront, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all six blueprints and seven templates necessary for creating and deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack. For more details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

First, set up an account with NOWPayments to enable crypto transactions. Next, create your ebook and upload it to Google Drive for secure hosting. After that, write a Google Apps Script to automate the delivery process. Use Cloudflare Pages to host your sales page, ensuring it's publicly accessible. Finally, link your payment processor to your script to trigger delivery upon successful payment.

You can sell an ebook online by using NOWPayments for crypto processing, which eliminates the need for conventional payment platforms. Host your ebook on a platform like Google Drive and automate delivery through a simple script.

The best way is to set up your own digital storefront using free tools. By utilizing NOWPayments for crypto payments, you avoid the high fees charged by traditional platforms, allowing you to retain more profit.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Yes, you can sell templates and fonts by creating your own website and using NOWPayments to accept crypto payments. This approach gives you full control over your products and sales process.
What are the fees associated with using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments charges a minimal fee of 0.5% per transaction, significantly lower than the 10% fee charged by platforms like Gumroad. This allows you to retain more of your revenue.

You can automate product delivery by writing a Google Apps Script that triggers file sharing from Google Drive upon confirming a payment through NOWPayments. This ensures customers receive their products instantly.
